announcements.headline: Glencore increases to 100% TVL Offtake
announcements.insight: Glencore increases its TVL offtake to 100%, following earlier site visits and government support. This confirms a strategic partnership progression for Alkemy Capital Investments.

announcements.headline: Loan Conversion
announcements.insight: Alkemy Capital Investments reports a second loan conversion in August. This follows TVL securing government support and establishing a validation centre in September.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results are released. This follows TVL securing government support and establishing a validation centre.

announcements.headline: TVL to Establish Qualification & Validation Centre
announcements.insight: TVL establishes a qualification centre, following government support in September. This validates progress for Alkemy Capital Investments' investment.

announcements.headline: Glencore visits TVL site at Billingham
announcements.insight: Glencore visits TVL site at Billingham. This follows the Jul partnership announcement and Sep government support, indicating ongoing operational progress.

announcements.headline: TVL Secures £18.3m UK Government Support
announcements.insight: Tees Valley Lithium secured £18.3m government support, following its July partnership with E3 Lithium Refining. This funding likely advances the joint venture established in July.

announcements.headline: Loan Conversion
announcements.insight: Alkemy Capital Investments announces a loan conversion following its July partnership with TVL and E3 Lithium Refining. This suggests capital restructuring within that specific venture.

announcements.headline: Loan Conversion
announcements.insight: Loan conversion follows the TVL and E3 Lithium partnership announced in July. Shareholders should monitor how this debt restructuring impacts the group's capital structure.

announcements.headline: TVL and E3 Lithium Refining Partnership
announcements.insight: Alkemy Capital Investments announces a partnership with E3 Lithium Refining. This follows the publication of an Impact Report for Tees Valley Lithium in June.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results are published. Shareholders should monitor future filings for any strategic updates following the June impact report.

announcements.headline: Tees Valley Lithium: Publication of Impact Report
announcements.insight: Alkemy Capital Investments has published an impact report regarding Tees Valley Lithium. Shareholders should monitor this for potential implications on the investment portfolio.
